data.one_liner: Customizable text input widget for creating chips from text in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides an AdvancedChipsInput widget that allows users to type and convert text into interactive chips. It supports features like chip deletion, input validation, backspace key handling, and customizable decorations and text styles.
use_when: You need to allow users to input a list of tags or mentions in a form.
You want built-in input validation for individual chips.
You require customization of chip containers, text styles, and delete icons.
avoid_when: You need complex autocomplete or asynchronous chip suggestions.
You are looking for a standard Material ChoiceChip or FilterChip group without a text input field.
strengths: Supports input validation before creating a chip.
Handles backspace key events for deleting chips automatically.
Offers broad styling options including widget and chip container decorations.
weaknesses: Lacks built-in asynchronous suggestion or autocomplete capabilities.
Limited to basic text-to-chip conversion features.
